propositions: Replace per-criterion fan-out recovery (1 LLM run per criterion) with banked incremental verification at the CompletionAgentStep seam, recording criterion verdicts mid-run with deterministic IDs and resuming unverified remainder in batched successor runs.

Implement a run-scoped criterion bank (git-ignored, schema-versioned, idempotent upsert) that tracks verified criteria by ID+text with ticket/material/tree-sha stamps, enabling successors to validate provenance and emit full-coverage verdicts (verified criteria + unverified placeholders) even when recovery partially exhausts.

Replace the flat 480-step primary budget floor with criteria-scaled verify_step_floor(c)=clamp(8c,48,480), reducing token waste on low-criteria tickets and lowering recovery frequency; couple with path-normalized read_file memo (cache whole-file once, slice all ranges) to collapse the measured 77% re-read tax.

Budget the recovery pool as a function of criteria count: global=1.5×N where N=ceil(floor/2), allocate per-run floor(pool/runs), convert requests to iterations via 2×B, and apply a zero-progress breaker (stop if a successor banks nothing new) to bound total cost below the 440-request fan-out worst case.

Close the verdict-less trap via deterministic fallback: if the LLM finalizer fails twice with any banked criteria, emit a full-coverage verdict directly from the bank (met flags as-is, unbanked as met=false), stamped deterministic_fallback with certifiable=false rather than repeating the failure spiral.

Validate coverage by criterion ID (order-insensitive, retry-on-missing preserved) and propagate certifiable+finalizer fields through gate_ops completion_reconcile to the signing path to withhold certification when the deterministic fallback was invoked.
